description:
Two near-constant values in `rss_parser.cr` are not actually constants:

1. `MAX_ENTITY_DEFINITIONS = 10` is declared **inside the `parse_xml` method body** (around line 92). Method-local consts are recreated on every call and harder to find when reading the class top-down.

2. `EMPTY_FEED_METADATA = FeedMetadata.new` at the top of the file uses constant naming for what is actually a mutable `FeedMetadata` record value (record fields are, but the variable slot is not actually frozen at the language level in Crystal).

Actions:
1. Move `MAX_ENTITY_DEFINITIONS` out of the method to a class constant on `RSSParser` (or on the new `BaseFeedParser` from fetcherc-9qn.11).
2. Replace `EMPTY_FEED_METADATA` reads with `FeedMetadata::EMPTY` (which already exists on the `FeedMetadata` record at the bottom of `entry_parser.cr`). Delete the local definition in rss_parser.cr entirely. This also addresses the related cleanup idea in openspec/009 — there's a single source of truth.

Acceptance: grep for `MAX_ENTITY_DEFINITIONS` and `EMPTY_FEED_METADATA` in `src/fetcher/rss_parser.cr` returns zero matches; both names refer to canonical declarations elsewhere; specs pass.
title: Promote MAX_ENTITY_DEFINITIONS and EMPTY_FEED_METADATA to real constants
